hq_location.notes: Company profile lists headquarters as San Francisco, California.

public_docs.notes: Karbon has a searchable public Help Center with multiple knowledge-base article categories and a public API reference.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported latest round was September 2023, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

founded_year.notes: Karbon’s company release states it was founded in 2014.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights identifies the latest round as a $10.5 million Series B-II on September 18, 2023.

launched_6mo.notes: Karbon announced the Kai AI coworker launch on June 3, 2026, within the six months before the run date.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists plans and prices.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The currently listed open roles include no SDR, BDR, sales representative, business development representative, or account executive title.

model_provider.notes: Karbon’s AI terms expressly say the product implements artificial intelligence available with Microsoft Azure OpenAI service.

named_customers.notes: All four are identified on the customer stories page as customer firms.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists Billing Analyst, Senior Staff Accountant, and two Engineering Manager roles; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

compliance_certs.notes: Karbon states it successfully completed a SOC 2 Type 2 examination. No additional certifications are included because this cited claim names SOC 2.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Karbon’s integration page lists these systems. Zapier is an automation/integration platform, included as a visibly used sales/marketing-system signal.

product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes Karbon as accounting practice management software for firms; AI support is also described in Karbon’s launch material.
product_one_liner.value: Karbon is collaborative, AI-enabled practice-management software that brings workflow, client communications, and firm systems together for accounting and bookkeeping firms.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On October 6, 2026, Karbon announced Stuart Totman’s appointment as Chief Technology Officer.
